api_safety.backward_compatibility: Generation and analysis were already public for this allomorph under the retained card; the 2026-09-09 correction pass re-attributes the rule to this evidence-backed card and keeps the behaviour unchanged.

counterexamples.note: Neuter applied before reciprocal violates the documented extension-sequence convention; the shared analyzer/generator policy rejects the stack (see fortune.verbal.extensions.001), not the reciprocal itself.
Intensive or associative readings that share the -an- surface stay lexical; the analyzer reports the reciprocal reading and meaning disambiguation remains lexical.

examples.note: Fortune section 3.3.18 (Noun Class 15 infinitive list): ku-tarisan-a (to look at one another).
Fortune section 3.4.2.8: -pamhidz-ir-an- (give aid to one another), an attested applicative + reciprocal combination radical.
Hannan printed p. 2 (PDF p. 26): -ana KKoMZ v sfx > reciprocal & associative exts of R; kuda > kudana, kuranga > kurangana.
Constructed combination of the attested -an- extension with a fixture radical under the supported present construction.

notes: Hannan states the meaning: the reciprocal ext indicates that the action is performed on one another by two or more agents.
The available sources attest the extension and example radicals but do not state a per-lemma productivity rule; per-lemma gaps remain possible and stay documented here.
Sequence position: the documented product convention places reciprocal after applicative and before reversive; attested -pamhidz-ir-an- (applicative then reciprocal) conforms.

rule_summary: Reciprocal extension -an-: the action is performed on one another by two or more agents; attested radicals include -tarisan-, -nzwan-, -vengan-, -pamhidz-ir-an-, -kudan-, -rangan-.
source_locator: Fortune, Shona Grammatical Constructions Vol. 1 (1985): section 3.3.18 Noun Class 15, PDF pp. 90-91 (printed pp. 78-79), ku-tarisan-a 'to look at one another'; section 3.4.2.8, PDF p. 110 (printed p. 98), -pamhidz-ir-an- 'give aid to one another' and -nzw-an-/-veng-an- in the class 11 list. Cross-checked in Hannan dictionary, printed p. 2 (PDF p. 26): '-ana KKoMZ v sfx > reciprocal & associative exts of R; kuda > kudana: to love one another; kuranga > kurangana'.
title: Reciprocal extension -an-
